counts.limits: Template alternatives are grouped per position. No Forever spawn counts, probabilities, timers, or lockpicking requirements are asserted. External quest givers, other wings, and ordinary trash are omitted.

decisions: Use client Part 3 only; it spans the Armory arrival, halls and Herod chamber.
The dungeon-wide default arrival belongs to Graveyard. Use Armory teleport trigger 612 instead.
Resolve ID-zero containers through gameobject_spawn_entry; do not display alternatives as separate simultaneously active containers.
Keep ordinary chest positions separate from Armor Crate / Weapon Crate positions.
Herod links the existing shared quest 1053 and Armory Drops; do not project Raleigh or other external givers inside.
No quest/drop records or completion storage are changed. Browser checks are left to the user.
